name: More Mobs
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Tschipcraft
description: Humanoid mobs get new variants through over 85 custom player heads or unused vanilla mobs! No Resource Pack needed!
works: A data pack in a mod: zombies, skeletons, husks, drowned, piglins, illagers and others get new variants with custom player heads; /function more_mobs:settings shows a settings menu in chat.
note: Not yet: Its global settings through MidnightLib (a settings screen) don't open under Kiln; the per-world chat menu works without them.
